text:
ethan-finops: FYI Stripe opened a dispute for acct `cus_J8x...` for $47,200 — code `chargeback_fraud` from card network. We need dispute evidence by EOW.
maya-billing: ack. Do we have the signed SOW + invoices? invoice INV-2026-0032 covers most of that amount.
sonia-support: I pulled the SOW PDF and the signed checkout confirmation, attaching link: https://redwood.internal/filestore/SOW_INV-2026-0032 (internal only).
reid-customer-success: Customer (Acme Retail) confirmed usage and has screenshots of the admin console showing request IDs. I'll ping them for a statement of acceptance.
ethan-finops: Need technical evidence too: API call logs, IPs, provisioning timestamps, and model usage token counts per day. Also need a copy of our refund/term page that was visible at purchase time.
sonia-support: For usage logs: run `SELECT request_id, user_id, model, tokens, ip, timestamp FROM prod.edge_logs WHERE customer_id='acme_retail' AND timestamp >= '2026-02-01'` — I exported a CSV and dropped it in the shared folder: https://redwood.internal/exports/acme_dispute_1753199999.csv
fraud-bot: [automated] Risk flag set: HIGH_SUSPECT_ACTIVITY. Recent login pattern shows multiple failed card attempts 2026-02-03 -> 2026-02-04.
maya-billing: Stripe wants "proof of service" — simplest is invoice + API logs + customer-signed acceptance email. We have invoice and SOW, need a clear mapping showing the delivered tokens/time ranges that match the invoice.
reid-customer-success: Got confirmation email from acct admin: "we confirm the services were received and used" — copying the body here: "we used the inference endpoints for product X between Feb 1-14. No refund requested."
ethan-finops: Can someone capture the console session that shows the run IDs? Also we should include the webhook delivery logs proving callbacks succeeded: `curl -I https://webhooks.acme/notify -H 'X-Request-ID: 9a4b'` (we have the response records).
sonia-support: Uploaded the webhook delivery log: https://redwood.internal/exports/webhook_logs_acme_1753199999.log
maya-billing: I started the dispute response draft in Stripe. Outline: 1) Invoice + SOW 2) Signed acceptance 3) API call logs + IPs 4) Webhook delivery logs 5) Business contact confirmation. Please add any other artifacts.
ethan-finops: Add the payments ledger entry and the authorization capture details (auth code `AUTH_3Z9`). Stripe specifically asked for authorization evidence and clear transaction timestamps.
reid-customer-success: Customer also included a billing contact phone call note (02/15) — attached in the Dropbox link.
ethan-finops: One complicating note: fraud-bot flagged several rapid subscription changes right before the dispute. Maya, can you check whether any refunds or credit memos were issued after the charge? If we credited anything accidentally we need to note it.
maya-billing: No manual refunds found. One automatic proration credit of $120 for plan change on 2026-02-10, unrelated to the disputed invoices. I'll list it in the timeline.
sonia-support: Timeline draft (short): charge captured 2026-02-05 16:11 UTC -> API usage 02/01-02/14 -> proration credit 02/10 -> customer acceptance email 02/16 -> dispute opened 03/01.
ethan-finops: Good. Last ask: legal needs a redacted copy to avoid PII leakage. Make a sanitized bundle: remove full card numbers, keep last4, and redact customer emails except the billing contact.
reid-customer-success: I'll produce the sanitized bundle and drop it in `/legal/incoming/disputes/ACME_1753199999.zip`.
fraud-bot: [automated] Dispute timeline token: 1753200001 logged.
maya-billing: Stripe deadline is 72 hours from opening. We have ~48 hours. I'll submit once Reid uploads the sanitized bundle and Ethan signs off on the evidence checklist.
ethan-finops: I'll review in 30m. If anything else, ping me @here. :thumbsup:
sonia-support: Also flagging account hold — do we want to place Acme on temporary hold for further provisioning?
maya-billing: Yes, put an account hold pending dispute resolution. I'll open the hold and add a note linking to the dispute ID `dp_1Hr9...`.
reid-customer-success: Hold is in place. Customer notified via billing@acme. "We have placed a temporary hold while we investigate."
ethan-finops: Perfect. After submission we'll monitor the Stripe case and prepare for a potential pre-arbitration request. Thanks team.
